reviews.title: Outstanding gaming headset. There aren’t much that match.
reviews.comment: Absolutely amazing headphones. Battery life straight out the package has been good all day. Decent range for a wireless headset. Accessible buttons on headset. Great mic. With my old headset, my friends could hear my fan and me chewing. They can’t hear anything in my background with this mic. Great sound quality. Being able to change the game volume and voice volume is amazing. Raise mic to mute is one of my favorite features in a mic. I will say that when I first put them on, they were tight on my head but after about 15 minutes, they fit my head just fine. Comfortable.
reviews.author: Tristan Allen

reviews.title: Worth the money
reviews.comment: A buddy recommended these to me. I got the 500’s and they’re the most comfortable headphones I’ve put on my head so far. Sound is good. Real good quality and worth the money. After years of just dealing with the pain of cheap headphones the upgrade is definitely worth it.
reviews.author: Holden

reviews.title: All-around decent headset that doesn’t break the bank.
reviews.comment:
Arrived in perfect condition. Packaged well.
It has been working perfectly for several weeks now. The bad reviews stating faulty receivers, spotty Bluetooth, weak headband, etc must be the exceptions, not the rule.  I use the receiver on my PS5 and Bluetooth for my phone and laptop.  It switches between them just fine as long as I press the right buttons.
There are a couple limitations with PS5 use due to Sony’s proprietary hardware policies:
1) Upon bootup, the PS5 senses the TB receiver and automatically sets sound output to the headset, regardless if the headset is powered up. So if you want to use external speakers, you have to use the PS5 sound menu to set output to your preferred device.
2) The headset dial to blend chat/game volume does not work for the PS5.  You have to use Sony Party Chat or in-game menus to control this. From what I’ve read, the dial does work on Xbox Series consoles though.
The master volume control dial works fine and has a wide range from very quiet to very loud.
I installed the headset’s Swarm II app on my phone. It’s nothing too fancy, but it functions as advertised.
Admittedly, I’m not a sound engineer/connoisseur, so I couldn’t say how the quality compares to other brands or models.  I’ll simply say that it sounds great to me. No complaints.
Very happy with my purchase.
reviews.author: Ian M.

reviews.title: Fantabulous
reviews.comment:
Love, love, LOVE!!!! I also loved my TB Stealth 700 Gen 2 Max, but the dongle gave out and will only work on my laptop now and I need something for my PS4. Didn't have $200 to spend, so I tried some crap headphones and those were all a h-e-double-hockey-sticks NO! Omg, I got spoiled af on the connecting to phone for music and being able to play on my PS and talk at the same time feature. I can never downgrade lol. Anyways, like I said I didn't (don't) have $200 for a new headset BUT I saw these for $80 from the Amazon warehouse "like new" condition and couldn't be happier!!! They are perfect and a god send!!!! Thank you!!!! I was worried from reviews and never buying from the warehouse before but I saw I could return if they weren't what I was expecting and they are fantabulous 🥰🥰🥰 I will say, I'm not sure if it was from whoever had them previously or me clicking things trying to figure the buttons out, for the first few days, after upgrading firmware, they were constantly disconnecting from the PS4, making numerous beeping noises, and I was thinking I may need to send them back, HOWEVER, I held down the top two buttons for 30 seconds or so, the headset powered off, it didn't power back on, but I powered it back on and they have been working flawlessly for the last few days. My friends have noticed no drops on my mic, I have no drops in my sounds and have it connected to both the PS4 and my phone. I love them so much, they are super comfy as well and I wear glasses, thank you for the fantastic deal I got them for, I am one happy gamer lady <3<3<3
Also, my friend who always complained about my mic, even when I had the gen 2 max (which nobody else did, so idk why he had issues with my mic) he even approves of these and said it's the best he's ever heard from me! So idk why google and such is saying that the gen 3's mic quality is worse than the gen 2's because they absolutely are not 😊
